action_summary: Kept the same checkpoints, transforms and TTA, and changed only the ensembling and post-processing of the raw EEG EEGNet predictions. Each TTA view of each fold model is now converted to a normalized probability distribution (sigmoid + row normalization) first, and these distributions are averaged across views and models, instead of averaging raw logits and applying sigmoid once; probability-space averaging is the standard choice for a KL-divergence target and produces better-calibrated, less overconfident ensembles. A small probability floor (1e-3) with renormalization was added before writing the submission to bound the KL penalty on confidently wrong samples. A helper function logits_to_probabilities and two flags (probability_space_ensemble, probability_floor) make the behavior switchable back to the previous logit averaging.
